cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're going to have a quick tutorial on the learning rate.
cues.zh: 今天快速談學習率。

cues.en: Alright, so let's recap what we have so far.
cues.zh: 先回顧目前內容。

cues.en: First, we have our dataset.
cues.zh: 首先有資料集。

cues.en: We apply the very first model, which is a simple model, yet still a model.
cues.zh: 套用第一個模型，很簡單但仍是模型。

cues.en: It's the average.
cues.zh: 就是平均。

cues.en: We just take the average of all the values.
cues.zh: 取全部值的平均。

cues.en: Then we add the second model, which is a decision tree applied to the residuals of the first model.
cues.zh: 第二個模型，是對第一個模型殘差套用的決策樹。

cues.en: Then we add the third model, which is a decision tree applied to the residuals of the second model.
cues.zh: 第三個，是對第二個模型殘差套用決策樹。

cues.en: And then we add a fourth model, which is a decision tree applied to the residuals of the third model.
cues.zh: 第四個，是對第三個殘差套用決策樹。

cues.en: And so on, the process keeps going.
cues.zh: 繼續下去。

cues.en: Now there's one new thing that we're going to introduce, and that is a coefficient.
cues.zh: 現在加入新東西，一個係數。

cues.en: So every decision tree in our model will get a coefficient called the learning rate.
cues.zh: 每棵決策樹都乘上一個叫學習率的係數。

cues.en: And here we can see it's set to 0.1, but it's up to you what you would like to set it to.
cues.zh: 這裡設 0.1，但可以自行決定。

cues.en: And what it does is the lower the learning rate, the longer it takes for the model, the overall ensemble model to learn,
cues.zh: 學習率越低，整個集成模型學得越久，

cues.en: because if we think about it, so we have that 0.54 value here.
cues.zh: 想想看，起始值是 0.54。

cues.en: If we had no coefficient here, or if we just used the one, that means the full value here would be added.
cues.zh: 沒有係數，或係數為 1，就加上這裡完整值。

cues.en: The full value here would be added.
cues.zh: 這裡加完整值。

cues.en: The full value here would be added, would be getting closer and closer and closer to the value we have in our training dataset.
cues.zh: 這裡也加完整值，越來越接近訓練資料值。

cues.en: But if we reduce this value and make it 0.1, it reduces value by 90%, or using only 10% of that value.
cues.zh: 但若設 0.1，就減少 90%，只用 10%。

cues.en: So we put 0.1 here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡乘 0.1。

cues.en: That means we won't get as close to the value of our data point in the original dataset, and that means the training will be slower.
cues.zh: 不會一次那麼接近原始點，訓練就較慢。

cues.en: So we need to, we'll need more passes, need more iterations to train this model.
cues.zh: 需要更多輪、更多迭代。

cues.en: And that is very useful to help prevent overfitting.
cues.zh: 有助避免過度擬合。

cues.en: Now, we already talked about Lambda, which is a regularization parameter in the similarity score, which helps prevent overfitting.
cues.zh: 先前談 lambda，是相似度分數的正規化參數，幫助避免過度擬合。

cues.en: The learning rate is not classified as a regularization parameter, but it also helps to prevent overfitting, because it extends the training process.
cues.zh: 講者沒有把學習率歸為正規化參數，但它也能藉延長訓練，幫助避免過度擬合。

cues.en: It makes it take longer to learn, for the algorithm to learn.
cues.zh: 讓演算法學得較久。

cues.en: And why is this necessary?
cues.zh: 為什麼需要？

cues.en: Well, our example's quite simplistic, and we're using very shallow decision trees, as you can see, and we're only using four of them.
cues.zh: 例子很簡單，用很淺的樹，而且只有四棵。

cues.en: But in reality, imagine decision trees like this or this depth or even this depth or even deeper.
cues.zh: 但實際上，想像這種深度、這種，甚至更深。

cues.en: So your decision tree could be as deep as you like, and typically it could be 10 levels deep, meaning that it can very closely model your dataset,
cues.zh: 決策樹可以很深，通常可能 10 層，能非常貼近資料，

cues.en: especially if your dataset isn't very, very big or very sophisticated.
cues.zh: 尤其資料集不大、不複雜。

cues.en: It can model your dataset quite easily, quite quickly, and especially if you have a hundred of these decision trees in a row.
cues.zh: 很容易、很快就能擬合，尤其連續有 100 棵樹。

cues.en: So you want to have that learning rate in order to prevent the algorithm from learning too quickly and overfitting to your training data.
cues.zh: 因此需要學習率，避免學太快、對訓練資料過度擬合。

cues.en: So that's what the learning is rate is about on an intuitive level.
cues.zh: 這是學習率的直覺。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
